g.text: Theme-based roadmap: Current, Near term, Future
themes with no fixed dates; each theme ties to an OKR
theme example: "reduce first-order drop-off" (no release date attached)
a release roadmap commits to features and dates: brittle when priorities change
the roadmap answers: what are we doing, why, and how does it tie to our OKRs?
a roadmap that is a release plan in disguise is the common mistake
